changelog:
- Operates Browser Use Cloud through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI.
- Runs agent browser tasks by creating or reusing Browser Use Cloud sessions.
- Supports session inspection, completion polling, message listing, and project session listing.
- Provides billing and plan lookup for the connected Browser Use Cloud account.
- Includes guarded handling for state-changing session stops and first-time auth/connection setup failures.

summary: Browser Use (browser-use.com). Use this skill for ANY Browser Use request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Browser Use, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
